commands: uv run pytest -q -n auto --dist loadscope tests/test_api

deviations.what: No fairdm/api/schema.py was written. The plan called for a drf-spectacular extension describing knox's header.
deviations.why: drf-spectacular 0.30.0 already ships one for knox. The generated schema carries a knoxApiToken header scheme and raises no warning about an unknown authenticator. A test fails on such a warning and was seen to fail with an authenticator drf-spectacular does not know.

deviations.what: One existing assertion outside the tests the brief names was changed: tests/test_conf/test_settings/test_api.py::TestApi::test_rest_framework_and_cors_are_present asserted CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS is False; it now asserts True.
deviations.why: That is the default this story replaces (FR-033). The full verify failed on it. Named in progress.md under T042 and in its own commit b45c4e66.

deviations.what: The knox app, the api extra of django-mvp-accounts and the shared token helper and fixture were added in the T037 commit, ahead of T042.
deviations.why: The T037 tests need knox's token table and a way to make a token. The old authenticator, dj-rest-auth and the old fixtures stayed until T042 so the suite stayed green between commits.

concerns: T040 (session read and CSRF-refused write) passed on first run because the API already accepted the session. Probe: removing SessionAuthentication from fairdm/api/settings.py turned both cases red.

T037's unknown-token cases and the T041 credentials and non-API-page cases also pass before the change; they guard against a later regression. The revoked and expired cases were made to fail first by sending the token once, expecting 200, then revoking or expiring it.

The spec edge case 'a portal restricts tokens to some people' is covered by django-mvp-accounts' own pages and documented in docs/portal-development/restful-api.md, but no test in this repo exercises MVP_ACCOUNTS_API_TOKEN_ACCESS.

Documented from django-mvp-accounts' README: restricting who may hold tokens does not delete tokens already held and is not consulted when a token is used (docs/portal-development/restful-api.md, docs/adr/0028).
The development server on port 8000 survived the dependency change and answers 200 on / and 302 (to sign in) on /account/tokens/.
CHANGELOG.md has no entry for this feature yet.
